critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/utils/keep-awake.ts — correct platform gate; the eslint-disable for rules-of-hooks is intentional and safe because `Platform.OS` is a build-time constant in production (RN web bundles never reach the expoUseKeepAwake call). Clean fix.

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:18-37 — `makeTabButton` correctly forwards testID and id, but the wrapper does not propagate `options.tabBarLabel` / `options.title` to the rendered Pressable children. The visible label comes from the `children` prop given by React Navigation, and in expo-router that fallback uses the route name when a custom tabBarButton is supplied without an explicit `tabBarLabel`. Hence the 'Community' regression.

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:123-128 — `href: null` works for the default tabBarButton but with the custom wrapper applied to siblings, React Navigation still creates a Pressable slot for the route; the calendar Tabs.Screen needs an explicit suppress (`tabBarButton: () => null`).
Pomodoro long-break math at /app/frontend/app/sanctuary/study.tsx:109-120 — `(cyclesDone + 1) % 4 === 0` correctly triggers long break on every 4th focus phase. Verified live.

rca_of_issue: Tab regressions RCA: React Navigation's bottom-tabs library treats `tabBarButton` as a complete replacement for the default tab slot — when supplied, neither the default 'render nothing for href:null' branch nor the 'render label from options.title' branch is taken. So (a) the calendar Tabs.Screen, which has `href: null` but NO `tabBarButton`, still gets the *default* slot (which now renders an outlined button reading the route name 'calendar' since href:null only nulls the link but not the slot in this version), and (b) the community Tabs.Screen, which DOES have a custom tabBarButton, receives a `children` prop that defaults to the route name when no explicit `tabBarLabel` is set. Both are documented edge cases of the React Navigation v6/v7 bottom-tabs API when mixing default and custom tab buttons in the same tablist. The fix is two one-line additions to _layout.tsx as listed in action_items.
